maria: quick datapoint from a 10k-request microprofile against canary kernel-picker -> host-side overhead spiked on small seqs, looks like request parse + tokenize + grpc writev is the culprit :grimacing:

maria: snapshot (top heavy paths):
```
handler.parse()           1.8ms
host.tokenize()           4.6ms   # up from ~1.2ms baseline
grpc.writev()             3.9ms   # many small iov vectors
kvcache.lookup()         0.25ms
ctx.serialize()           0.6ms
```

maria: count of writev calls per request jumped from ~2 -> ~8 on the canary machines. heap/allocs didn't move much.

sam: hmm did the kernel-picker change kernel for short seq paths?

maria: yes we switched default to avx_fastmem for seq<=64 at 3425000000 canary. suspect the codegen/cacheline layout changed small-chunk emission, causing more fragmented IO.

lee: can you paste the strace snippet for a single request? :eyes:

maria: strace sample (redacted):
```
writev(3, [{iov_base="\"{\n", iov_len=3}, {iov_base="tokenized_chunk1", iov_len=60}, {iov_base="tokenized_chunk2", iov_len=48}], 3) = 111
writev(3, [{iov_base="\"more\"", iov_len=6}], 1) = 6
```

maria: so grpc/HTTP2 framing ends up with extra frames because we flush multiple small writev calls.

anita: can we enable coalescing at the proxy layer or increase grpc internal max_write_iov? we tried coalesce=true last quarter for a similar microburst.

jordan: also check kvcache mutex contention — if tokenize is emitting many small buffers the cache lookup path might be interleaving and adding syscalls. any lock stalls?

maria: perf top shows negligible locks on canary, tokenize CPU dominates. not a kvcache stall right now.

sam: short checklist: 1) try reverting kernel-picker for seq<=64 on canary 2) run preflight with socket coalesce 3) instrument writev count metric 4) run 50k-run to validate tail latency.

maria: yep I'll revert the canary flag and run the coalesce preflight. opening a quick issue and will tag @lee/@anita for proxy tweak.

perf-bot: perf-regression-alert: 8.9ms increased p90 host-side latency on canary (metric: host_parse_token_overhead). link: https://perf.internal/runs/3425006789

lee: thanks. if revert fixes it we should add a micro-benchmark for emitted iov counts to catch this in CI.

anita: also consider adding a small aggregation pass in tokenizer to merge adjacent iovs before handing to grpc. cheap fix if feasible.

maria: plan: revert + coalesce preflight now, then tokenizer aggregation experiment in follow-up. will post short results in this thread. :thumbsup:
